name: smith kneeling rear kick
description: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
